name: Shoshone River — Cody (Demaris Hot Springs to Corbett Bridge)
blurb: Shoshone River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Belfry Bridge (Shoshone): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Corbett Bridge (Shoshone): exact agency facility pin. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (6.3 mi); no agency mileage found.

gaugeContext.note: This gauge below Buffalo Bill provides upstream flow context for the Cody reaches. It is above Corbett diversion and should not be treated as flow below that diversion.

flowSource.name: Shoshone River below Buffalo Bill
